content: Aside from MLM and TLM, we propose BRidge Language Modeling (BRLM) to further obtain word-level representation alignment between different languages. This method is inspired by the assumption that if the feature spaces of different languages are aligned very well, the masked words in the corrupted sentence can also be guessed by the context of the correspondingly aligned words on the other side. To achieve this goal, BRLM is designed to strengthen the ability to infer words across languages based on alignment information, instead of inferring words within monolingual sentence as in MLM or within the pseudo sentence formed by concatenating sentence pair as in TLM.
